expiry_behavior: expired or unapproved entries block tools/release_gate.py (verdict NO_GO)

entries.rationale: no accountable people named; ADR and reviews need them
entries.remediation: name holders in ops/OWNERS.json; approve ADR-0001

entries.rationale: GAP-02, GAP-11, INV-68, INV-69 not in this archive; CI matrix not executed
entries.compensating: contract-level adapters + integration tests; declared CI matrix

entries.rationale: GPU passthrough / local-inference runtime, drivers and execution isolation are owned by the host and GAP-11; nothing to pin here
entries.compensating: APPROVED_TECH lists the unpinned host items explicitly
entries.remediation: architecture board selects and pins host stack

entries.rationale: HMAC integrity only; no asymmetric signing, KMS or at-rest encryption available in-archive
entries.compensating: digest+HMAC on inventory, hash-chained journal and audit, SHA256SUMS manifest
entries.remediation: host KMS + signing service; encrypt journal at rest

entries.rationale: perf thresholds PROPOSED; no reference hardware; soak 60 s not 24 h; p99 at MAX_INVENTORY straddles the 10 ms SLO
entries.compensating: perf gate refuses quick results; bound-checked inputs
entries.remediation: run bench on perf-reference runner; approve thresholds; vectorise device validation

entries.compensating: matcher adds no accelerator load; CPU cost measured
entries.remediation: measure on a far-edge reference node

entries.rationale: release approval, runbook drills and incident exercises require named humans
entries.compensating: release gate fails closed; falsifier proves GO reachable
entries.remediation: approver named and signs release; drills recorded
